title: Answer: the self is a user illusion, a center of narrative gravity

statements.text: The self is a user illusion created by many unconscious subsystems acting together, a single unified agent and center of narrative gravity that is needed to describe others, each other and oneself. There is no inner observer, and the audience for the illusion of phenomenality is no smaller than the organism.

sources.quote: a self as a centre of narrative gravity
There need be no unified audience for the illusion smaller than the organism as a whole
